name: infographic-syntax-creator
title_zh: 笔记进来，AntV 图表 DSL 出去
tagline_zh: 给一段大纲或报告，它替你选模板、理数据结构、配主题提示词，直接产出 Infographic 语法。不用打开渲染器。
tagline_en: Feed it an outline or report; it picks the template, shapes the data, and hints the theme, outputting Infographic.
desc_en: Generate AntV Infographic syntax only. Use when asked to turn notes, outlines, reports, or other user content into the Infographic DSL with template selection, data structuring, and theme hints. Do not use for HTML rendering or TS/TSX component implementation.
why_zh: 它只认 Infographic DSL 这一种输出，把选模板、定数据、配主题的决策全包了。
why_en: It commits to one output—Infographic DSL—and owns the decisions on template, data layout, and theme hints, so you just supply.
limit_zh: 只产出 Infographic DSL 语法，不负责 HTML 渲染或 TS/TSX 组件实现。
limit_en: Outputs Infographic DSL only; no HTML rendering or TS/TSX. Needs structured text input; raw images or sketches won't work.
title_en: Notes in, AntV chart DSL out—no HTML, no TS
